    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Ball
    Represents the ball in the ping pong game.
    BallManager
    Controls ball movement during the game.
    CollisionManager
    Handles collision detection between the ball and the rackets.
    Controller
    Central controller that provides access to the game model.
    DatabaseConnection
    Singleton class responsible for managing the database connection.
    Game
    Represents the full state of the ping pong game.
    Game.Builder
    Static inner Builder class used to reconstruct a Game object step by step.
    GameDAO
    DAO class responsible for saving and loading Game data from the relational database.
    GameMenu
    Creates and manages the menu bar used in the game window.
    GameService
    Service layer class responsible for coordinating game-related database operations.
    GoalManager
    Detects when a goal is scored and updates the game state.
    KeyboardListener
    Listens for keyboard events and keeps track of which keys are currently pressed.
    LabCanvas
    Custom JavaFX canvas used to draw the game interface.
    Main
    Main JavaFX application class for the Super Ping_Pong game.
    MemoryExperiment
    Runs JVM memory experiments for heap and stack limits.
    MenuListener
    Handles menu actions triggered from the game menu.
    Player
    Represents a player in the ping pong game.
    PositionedObject
    Abstract base class for all game objects that have a position in the game area.
    Racket
    Represents a player's racket in the ping pong game.
    RacketManager
    Controls the movement of both player rackets.
    Resizable
    Defines behaviour for objects that must adjust their size and position when the game window is resized.
    SerializationService
